summary: This is a pre-registration document (protocol v0.3, deposited 12 November 2026) for ARGUS-OS1, a study investigating whether inherited centriole age (OLD vs NEW) determines interdivision timing in immortalized fibroblasts (BJ-hTERT, MRC5-hTERT). At the time of deposit, no biological data, images, or pilot runs exist — the document fixes the analysis plan, sample size, stopping rules, and endpoints in advance. It is a prospective registration at TRL 1–2, with a synthetic readout benchmark already completed but primary experiments not yet started.

content_blocks.title: Project Identity and Prospective Status
content_blocks.content: Project ARGUS-OS1, authored by Jaba Tqemaladze, MD (Georgia Longevity Alliance; PhD applicant, UNED Madrid, Programa 9620), ORCID 0000-0001-8651-7243. Protocol v0.3, dated 12 November 2026, with three amendments (Amendment 1: senescence endpoint; Amendment 2: sampling requirement, power, readout acceptance test; Amendment 3: feasibility of maintaining two cells). Deposited 12 November 2026 under CC-BY-4.0. Explicitly states: 'At the time of this deposit there are no images, no tracked lineages, no pilot run and no biological data of any kind for this protocol.' This is a pure pre-registration with no experimental results yet. Relies on a synthetic readout benchmark (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24148459, 12 November 2026).

content_blocks.title: Research Questions and Hypotheses
content_blocks.content: Q1 (background, not tested): Normal fibroblasts have a division limit (Hayflick limit, ~50 divisions). Q2 (primary): Do immortalized lines BJ-hTERT and MRC5-hTERT show an analogous division limit? H1: A limit exists even with hTERT expression — much larger, masked at population level by rapid colony growth. H0: No limit; true 'immortality' in the observation window. Q3 (mechanism): Does division rate depend on the age of the inherited centriole (OLD vs NEW)? Q2 and Q3 are separate claims, measured and reported separately. 'No limit in the window' is a valid answer to Q2.

content_blocks.title: Endpoints
content_blocks.content: Primary endpoint: Trend of interdivision interval, OLD versus NEW centriole carriers, over time — stable, converging, or diverging. Under H1, expected signal is progressive slowing of OLD relative to NEW. Secondary endpoints: mitosis duration; divisions per lineage; fraction of quiescent cells; daughter-size symmetry; cohort growth-curve slope. Cell lines: BJ-hTERT and MRC5-hTERT; ≥3 independent experiments × 2 lines. Controls (pre-registered): unpurified mixed culture as population rate reference; marker control (Cep164-RFP without removal); sham procedure; ≥3 technical positions per run. Statistical tests: Mann–Whitney or log-rank for interdivision-time distributions; mixed models or rank-based trend tests for OLD-vs-NEW trend over time; medians with 95% CI and effect size.

content_blocks.title: Stopping Criteria
content_blocks.content: Three pre-registered stopping criteria: (1) OLD/NEW divergence in interdivision interval is statistically significant; OR (2) lineages reach the senescence endpoint; OR (3) the window ends without (1) or (2) → conclusion recorded as 'not detected in the window', with the boundary of the conclusion stated. Window extension only if data justify it. Horizon: ≥N generations or ≥6 months, whichever comes first (not 'until 800–1000 divisions').

content_blocks.title: Operational Definition of Senescence Endpoint
content_blocks.content:
A lineage is called senescent when D1 AND D2 cross their thresholds. D3 is confirmatory only at fixed-sample endpoint.

| Criterion | Definition | Measurable from |
|---|---|---|
| D1 — durable proliferation arrest | Interdivision interval of tracked lineage, censored at window end; arrest = no division over a pre-registered multiple of that lineage's own baseline interval | Tracking log alone |
| D2 — dispersion / asymmetric lineage behaviour | Pre-registered threshold on lineage-level divergence (see protocol §4a) | Tracking log alone |
| D3 — molecular markers | SA-β-gal; p16INK4a / p21; loss of Ki67 | Fixed-sample endpoint only |

Decision rule: D1 with D2 negative = 'arrest of undetermined cause' — counts as arrest for Q2, does NOT count as senescence, difference reported explicitly.

content_blocks.title: Sampling Requirement (Mandatory Gate)
content_blocks.content: Sampling must be 100 nm/px or finer; binning above 2×2 is not allowed. Basis: readout benchmark (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24148459, 12 November 2026). Benchmark results: detection recall 0.78 at ~80 nm/px, falling to 0.46 at ~250 nm/px as centriole pairs merge, and 0.30 under 1.9 px defocus. At coarser sampling the pipeline returns plausible but wrong lineages. This is a gate condition, not a preference.

content_blocks.title: Sample Size and Power Calculation
content_blocks.content: Target: detecting a 2-hour difference in interdivision interval between oldest-centriole and newest-centriole carriers. Parameters: α = 0.05 two-sided, power = 0.80, between-cell interval spread σ ≈ 6 h (from literature range), localisation error converted through frame cadence. Analysis floor: n ≈ 115 cells per group (~230 tracked lineages per line before attrition). Recruitment target: 150 per group per line (to account for lineages lost to removal procedure, tracking failure, and senescence censoring). The analysis floor is recalculated after Phase 0 replaces the literature σ with a measured value — before the primary endpoint is examined.

content_blocks.title: Readout Acceptance Test — Stop Condition
content_blocks.content:
The analysis chain (centriole detection, identity persistence, interval extraction) must clear on the phantom with the frozen seed at the configured sampling:

| Metric | Threshold | Status at deposit |
|---|---|---|
| Localisation RMSE | ≤ 0.6 px | MET in benchmark (0.38 px at resolvable sampling) |
| Detection recall | ≥ 0.75 | MET (0.78) |
| Detection precision | ≥ 0.90 | MET (0.92) |
| Interdivision interval MAE | ≤ 1.0 h | NOT YET MEASURED — must be implemented and run with production tracker on same phantom; failing it stops the pilot |

Three of four metrics met in the synthetic benchmark. The interval MAE metric is not yet implemented.

content_blocks.title: Scope Limitations and Feasibility Fallback
content_blocks.content: Explicit exclusions: (1) No biological claim — phantom is a simulation calibrating instrument and analysis only. (2) σ from literature, not yet measured in these lines; Phase 0 will replace it. (3) Interval MAE not yet implemented. (4) No therapeutic claim — pilot measures division timing in fibroblasts only; lifespan, immune function, and interventions are outside endpoints. (5) Feasibility fallback: if no level-1 removal method meets both survival and accuracy requirements, the pair is maintained by periodic manual splitting with identity re-anchored by pedigree at each split — documented design change with re-costed sample size.

content_blocks.title: File Manifest and Integrity
content_blocks.content: Files in deposit: ARGUS_Protocol_v0.3.md (sha256: 7486b95f258a96a110fb6073ab1ce6566f1b00f28ba21414929c1e2daa043d7a) and PREREGISTRATION_2026-11-12.md (sha256 in SHA256SUMS.txt). Amendments 1–3 are part of protocol v0.3. Companion documents: ARGUS_TRD_v0.9b, ARGUS_label_free_centriole_assignment, TRL evidence pack (12 November 2026). Prepared with AI assistance for search and formatting; every scientific claim verified against PMID/DOI.

key_findings: At time of deposit (12 November 2026), NO biological data, images, tracked lineages, or pilot runs exist — this is a pure pre-registration at TRL 1.
Primary hypothesis: inherited centriole age (OLD vs NEW) determines interdivision timing in immortalized fibroblasts (BJ-hTERT, MRC5-hTERT).
Secondary hypothesis: immortalized lines may have a hidden division limit analogous to the Hayflick limit, masked at population level.

Synthetic readout benchmark (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24148459) completed: localisation RMSE 0.38 px (threshold ≤0.6 px), detection recall 0.78 (threshold ≥0.75), detection precision 0.92 (threshold ≥0.90) — 3 of 4 acceptance metrics met.
Interdivision interval MAE metric (threshold ≤1.0 h) not yet implemented — this is a stop condition for the pilot.
Power calculation: n≈115 cells/group analysis floor, 150/group/line recruitment target, to detect 2-hour difference in interdivision interval (α=0.05, power=0.80, σ≈6h from literature).
Mandatory sampling gate: ≤100 nm/px, no binning above 2×2; detection recall drops from 0.78 at ~80 nm/px to 0.46 at ~250 nm/px.
Senescence endpoint operationally defined using D1 (proliferation arrest) + D2 (lineage divergence) as primary criteria; D3 (SA-β-gal, p16INK4a/p21, Ki67) confirmatory only.
Cell lines to be used: BJ-hTERT and MRC5-hTERT; ≥3 independent experiments per line.
Feasibility fallback documented: if centriole removal fails, manual splitting with pedigree-based identity re-anchoring will be used as a design change.
